sloka: होता अध्वर्युः तथ उद्गाता हस्तेन समयोजयन् ।महिष्या परिवृत्त्या अथ वावाताम् अपराम् तथा ॥१-१४-३५॥
transliteration: hotā adhvaryuḥ tatha udgātā hastena samayojayan ।mahiṣyā parivṛttyā atha vāvātām aparām tathā ॥1-14-35॥

translations.english: The king at appropriate time and in agreement with the scriptures inhaled the odour of the smoke (from the burnt marrow) and absolved himself of his sins.
